name: Memories Imposing
description: Recreation of the attached AU_MTF patch: analog saw/square spine, AC-hum noise bed, slow imposing filter. The hum stays at 60 Hz while the bass tracks pitch.

fx: EQ — Low shelf +2.5 dB @ 75 Hz, dip −1.5 dB @ 280 Hz
serum.notes: Leave the AC hum un-keyed so it sits at 60 Hz. High-pass the noise around 40 Hz so it does not fight the sub. Play C1–C2, mono, slight glide.

name: Ghost Hum
description: Thinner oscillator, louder electrical bed. For breakdowns and tension fills.

serum.notes: Ride Macro 4. Keep OSC A quiet so the hum is the character.

name: Grid Voltage
description: 60 Hz harmonic stack beating against a slightly sharp saw. Warehouse tension.

serum.notes: Keep it mono. The beating is the point.

name: Afterhours
description: Dusty round bass, slow chorus, tape-like saturation. 2am closer.

serum.notes: Longer release. Let it bloom into the next chord.

name: Night Bus
description: Clean round tech-house sub. Sine + barely-there saw. Translates on a club system.

serum.notes: The saw is only there so the sub reads on small speakers. Keep it mono under 140 Hz.

name: Warehouse Pillar
description: A column of sub. Slight clip, almost no mid. Drop this under a perc loop.

serum.notes: OSC C is the true sub. Do not unison it.

name: Velvet Floor
description: Saturated sine that kisses the speakers instead of punching them.

serum.notes: Longer attack. Sits under pads without fighting them.

name: Last Call
description: Tired round bass with a dotted delay ghost. Last-song material.

serum.notes: Mute delay on the last bar of a phrase.

name: Velvet Reese
description: Classic two-saw reese, not screamy. Works in house and DnB at different octaves.

serum.notes: Drop an octave for 174 DnB. Keep OSC C mono.

name: Mono Nerve
description: Reese folded into mono. Aggressive mid, no stereo smear.

serum.notes: Designed to sit under a vocal without stereo fight.

name: Frozen FM
description: Bell-adjacent FM bass. Icy, useful as a mid-bass over a sine sub.

serum.notes: OSC B is FM source — keep its level at 0 and route via warp.

name: Chrome Split
description: Hard-panned dual saws. Huge on headphones, still has a mono sub.

serum.notes: Check in mono — the sub must survive.

name: Acid Memory
description: 303-style square with a hungry filter envelope. Classic acid, not cartoon.

fx: EQ — 300 Hz dip if it honks
serum.notes: Program 16th sequences with accent on offbeats. Env 2 is the instrument.

name: Rolling Square
description: Less resonant than Acid Memory. Rolls under a 126 groove without stealing the hats.

serum.notes: Sequence in 16ths, leave gaps. The saw just thickens the square.

name: Heatwave
description: Resonance pushed into self-oscillation territory. Handle with a high-cut.

serum.notes: Put a safety LP at 6 kHz on the channel. This one screams.

name: Concrete 808
description: Sine 808 with a pitch drop. Hard enough for trap, round enough for house.

matrix: Env 2 → OSC A Pitch (+12 to +19 st)
serum.notes: Tune per track. Pitch env is Env 2 → pitch, 50–80 ms decay.

name: Soft Clipper
description: Same 808 body, pushed into soft clip so it stays loud on small speakers.

serum.notes: Gain-stage so the clipper is the loudness, not the channel fader.

name: Low Voltage
description: Short 808 / kick-bass hybrid. Use as a pattern bass, not a drone.

serum.notes: Program like a kick. Leave space on the 2 and 4 if a real kick is in the track.

name: Pressure Cooker
description: Everything into the tube. Mid-bass that shoves a mix forward.

serum.notes: Watch the 250 Hz build-up. High-pass anything else in that region.

name: Dirt Organ
description: Drawbar-ish harmonic stack into mild foldback. Church-basement bass.

serum.notes: OSC A/B/C are 8', 4', 2' drawbars. Blend, don't unison.

name: Deep Fold
description: West-coast fold on a sine. Harmonics bloom as you lean on Drive.

serum.notes: Play with one finger and ride Macro 1. The fold is the melody.

name: Chrome Wobble
description: Quarter-note filter wobble, metallic saw. Hold a note and ride Dark.

serum.notes: Lock LFO to host. Change rate to 1/8 for half-time drops.

name: Silk Distortion
description: Slow sine on the filter, gentle tape. Hypnotic rather than wobbly.

serum.notes: One-bar LFO. Works as a pad-bass under chords.

name: Analog Spine
description: PWM bass with a slow pulse-width LFO. The backbone of a 126 track.

serum.notes: Closest cousin to Memories Imposing without the loud hum. A 126 default bass.
